records.claim_text: GovS 002 distinguishes higher sponsoring authority, the accountable SRO owning the business case, and day-to-day programme/project management; the SRO escalates decisions outside delegated authority.
records.limitations: Do not substitute public SRO titles for private employer roles or infer a universal approval chain.
records.population: Source-scoped government framework, not an observed employer sample
records.review_mode: GovS 002 relevant original online HTML sections read via browser tooling; retained captures are explicitly parsed browser text extracts, not original HTML or PDF.

records.claim_text: GovS 002 places assurance assessment before significant decisions and requires decision-makers, consultation and review type to be defined for each gate.
records.limitations: Review recommendations are inputs; this wording alone does not assign reviewers authority to approve funds or go-live.
records.population: Source-scoped government framework, not an observed employer sample
records.review_mode: GovS 002 relevant original online HTML sections read via browser tooling; retained captures are explicitly parsed browser text extracts, not original HTML or PDF.

records.claim_text: GovS 002 allows proportionate governance, conditional or phased decisions, and outcomes including revision, deferral or termination.
records.limitations: Government project provisions do not impose the same stages, gates or thresholds on private routine renewals.
records.population: Source-scoped government framework, not an observed employer sample
records.review_mode: GovS 002 relevant original online HTML sections read via browser tooling; retained captures are explicitly parsed browser text extracts, not original HTML or PDF.

records.claim_text: GovS 008 separates contract justification/business ownership, commercial leadership, signature under delegation and day-to-day contract management; specialist commercial roles can be advisory or executive.
records.limitations: Government standard; these rights may be combined or distributed in an actual case. Title does not establish authority.
records.population: Source-scoped government framework, not an observed employer sample
records.review_mode: GovS 008 relevant original online HTML sections read; original HTML retained and hashed. No PDF visual review applies.

records.claim_text: GovS 008 identifies offer invitation, award recommendation, payment, extension/change and termination as distinct decisions within the organisation’s controls, with commercial and project decisions aligned.
records.limitations: Do not read these as a universal fixed sequence or import public-spending controls into private payroll procurement.
records.population: Source-scoped government framework, not an observed employer sample
records.review_mode: GovS 008 relevant original online HTML sections read; original HTML retained and hashed. No PDF visual review applies.

records.claim_text: GovS 006 describes delegated budget holders separately from finance business partners who support and challenge them; specialist finance roles can be advisory or executive according to assignment.
records.limitations: Not proof that finance advice is a binding veto, or that every CFO personally approves every payroll change.
records.population: Source-scoped government framework, not an observed employer sample
records.review_mode: GovS 006 original PDF sections 4.4.5-4.4.7 read; printed pp15-16 / PDF pp19-20 rendered and visually checked. Original PDF retained and hashed.

records.claim_text: FRC guidance distinguishes board delegation and committee advice from retained board responsibility for the risk/control framework and management’s day-to-day implementation; delegations should be explicit.
records.limitations: Non-mandatory guidance supporting the Code for specified listed categories, not all private employers or individual payroll approvals.
records.population: In-scope listed-company governance guidance, not observed payroll decisions
records.review_mode: FRC relevant original online HTML sections and numbered paragraphs read; original HTML retained and hashed. No PDF visual review applies.

records.locator: SaaS customers / Authorise payments; Source customers / Authorise payments
records.claim_text: Cintra distinguishes approval/submission of payroll from BACS payment authorisation according to service/payment route.
records.limitations: Does not show who can purchase the platform, approve investment, sign contracts or release funds outside that supplier workflow.
records.review_mode: Cintra relevant sections re-read from the existing retained original HTML capture for SRC-0131; capture hash reverified. No PDF visual review applies.

records.claim_text: R04 should code the right exercised at a dated decision separately from job title, sponsorship, influence, assurance, signature and operational approval.
records.limitations: An analytical recommendation, not an empirical finding that all organisations use these roles or a proposal to change the 14-question core.
records.review_mode: Cross-source analytical method recommendation based on source-specific reviews in GOV4-C01-C08; not a separate PDF review or empirical observation.

records.claim_text: Case coding should distinguish a concern or recommendation from a binding condition, establish who can clear or escalate it, and preserve decision disposition separately from implementation.
records.limitations: Actual conditions and decision rights remain to be established from original practitioner cases; do not impose a mandatory private workflow.
records.review_mode: Cross-source analytical method recommendation using the specified GovS 002 and GovS 008 sections; not a separate PDF review or empirical observation.
